type: development coverage audit of an optional vehicle-relative parking fallback
decision: The stand-alone fallback was omitted from the release. The measurements describe an offline candidate-selection experiment.
cohort: Managed public KartaView photos with source-bound, signed vehicle observations. This was an existing gallery, not an unseen passenger study.

measured_outlines.relations: Behind a visibly rear-facing vehicle, or on its left or right beside the bumper. Each option had to be unique, on connected parking pavement and free of tracked objects.

interpretation: These counts measure additional coverage. They do not estimate accuracy of the app's primary signed rear-point route or the passenger-mark route.
